tool_input.description: Check whether isInterrupted() survives thread termination

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/ThreadUtilsAgentTest.java` with 44 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `ThreadUtils`: the various `findThreadById`/`findThreads`/`findThreadGroups` overloads (null checks, matches, mismatches, empty results, unmodifiable collections), `getAllThreads`/`getAllThreadGroups`/`getSystemThreadGroup`, `join`/`sleep`/`sleepQuietly` (including negative-duration errors, null-duration no-ops, and timeout vs. completion behavior), and the deprecated `NamePredicate`, `ThreadIdPredicate`, and `ALWAYS_TRUE_PREDICATE` constructs. All tests compile under `--release 8` with no lambdas/diamonds/try-with-resources, and `./_tools/test.sh` reports 44/44 passing with no regressions to the existing suite.
